purpose: Per-page professional boundary block. Every public page states, in its own words, that ApprovalPrep is not a law firm or a licensed financial professional and is not a substitute for one, and points to a free authoritative resource for the situation that page is about.
sourceVerification: Every url below was requested over HTTPS on 2026-08-27 and returned 200 at the url as written. Do not add a url here without checking it the same way.

credit.heading: Before you send a credit letter
credit.body: ApprovalPrep is not a law firm and not a credit repair company, and this page is not legal advice. A letter template is not a substitute for an attorney or a credit counselor. Get real advice first if the debt is in collections, if you have been sued, or if you are not sure an item is wrong. You send the letter yourself, and what it says is on you.

resources.label: CFPB: how to dispute an error on your credit report
AnnualCreditReport.com: the free federal credit report site

lending.heading: Before you send this to a lender
lending.body: ApprovalPrep is not a law firm, a lender, or a licensed financial advisor, and this page is not legal or financial advice. A letter of explanation does not change what you owe or how an underwriter decides. It is not a substitute for advice about your own loan. If you are behind on a mortgage or worried about losing your home, talk to a HUD-approved housing counselor before you sign anything.

resources.label: CFPB: find a HUD-approved housing counselor (free)
CFPB: Owning a Home loan guide

rental.heading: Before you send this to a landlord
rental.body: ApprovalPrep is not a law firm and this page is not legal advice. A cover letter or reference letter cannot change what a screening report says, and it is not a substitute for a tenant lawyer if you are facing eviction or think you were turned down unfairly. Only put facts in your letter that you can back up.

resources.label: CFPB: what a tenant screening report is and your rights

employment.heading: Before you send this to an employer or verifier
employment.body: ApprovalPrep is not a law firm and not an HR or payroll advisor, and this page is not legal advice. An income or employment letter has to be true and has to come from someone allowed to confirm it. Never sign someone else's name. This page is not a substitute for an employment lawyer if your work records are being used against you.

resources.label: FTC: background checks and what employers must follow

business.heading: Before you send this to a funder
business.body: ApprovalPrep is not a law firm, an accountant, or a licensed financial advisor, and this page is not legal, tax, or financial advice. Business funding paperwork can create legal and tax duties, and a template is not a substitute for a lawyer or an accountant. Have one review anything you are unsure about before you sign it.

resources.label: SBA: official loan programs and free local help

general.heading: What this page is not
general.body: ApprovalPrep helps you get your own paperwork ready. It is not a law firm, a credit repair company, or a licensed financial advisor, and nothing here is legal or financial advice. It is not a substitute for talking to a lawyer, a tax professional, or a credit counselor about your own situation.

resources.label: CFPB: submit a complaint about a financial company
